LandingGenerator.title: Landing Generator
LandingGenerator.desc: A web application that automates the creation of complete, production-ready landing pages. It leverages the Gemini API (AI) for dynamic content generation based on predefined design templates.
LandingGenerator.resp1: Provided technical leadership and strategic decision-making for defining the application's functional and technical requirements.
LandingGenerator.resp2: Designed and engineered prompts (Prompt Engineering) for precise content generation and AI-driven HTML/CSS code structuring.
LandingGenerator.resp3: Developed a library of reusable design components and templates using HTML, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript.
LandingGenerator.resp4: Implemented automation modules to dynamically populate templates with AI-generated content.
LandingGenerator.resp5: Architected and developed the Gemini API (AI) integration, managing the data flow (request/response) and service orchestration.
LandingGenerator.resp6: Defined the deployment strategy and configured the cloud service infrastructure.

LatamNews.title: Latam News
LatamNews.desc: A financial news portal for Latam, developed from scratch. Features a custom CMS, SEO automation (sitemaps, metadata), and dynamic content generation assisted by AI.
LatamNews.resp1: Provided technical leadership in defining the platform's architecture and gathering functional and non-functional requirements.
LatamNews.resp2: Designed and implemented a Prompt Engineering (AI) system for content generation (summarization, translation) and the automatic, template-based creation of code structures (article pages).
LatamNews.resp3: Full leadership of the Frontend team, overseeing the development lifecycle (design, implementation, and QA) for all portal sections.
LatamNews.resp4: Defined the frontend's data architecture and state management. Designed rendering strategies (SSR/ISR) to optimize performance and SEO.
LatamNews.resp5: Collaborated closely with Backend for REST API design, data contract definition, and deployment architecture planning.
LatamNews.resp6: Developed automation scripts for dynamic sitemap and metadata generation (Technical SEO), ensuring proper content indexing.
